title.narrative: Empowering Ocean Science and Biodiversity Research through Enhanced Collaboration among Lusophone SIDS

description.narrative: Timor-Leste boasts exceptional marine and terrestrial biodiversity, encompassing globally significant ecosystems and endemic species within rich biodiversity areas and 30 declared Marine Protected Areas (MPAs). Marine and coastal ecosystems, tropical rainforests & mountains, and exotic flora and fauna constitute the country’s diverse ecosystems. Timor-Leste stands at a pivotal juncture where the reinforcement of ocean science and biodiversity research is imperative to advance sustainable practices in biodiversity conservation and marine management. Building on the National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan of Timor-Leste (2011-2020), this national project seeks to increase the country's research capacities in the areas of marine science and biodiversity, by strengthening institutional management system for protected areas and contributing to the establishment of a common research and training agenda, within the framework of the regional initiative led by Cape Verde, aiming to create a Center of Excellence dedicated to advancing research in Marine Sciences and Biodiversity, adapting to the specificities of the economically disadvantaged Portuguese-speaking SIDS (LDCs and LMIDs).
